newsitem.title: USA: Airgas to acquire Carbonic Industries.
newsitem.headline: Airgas to acquire Carbonic Industries.

text.p: Airgas Inc said on Tuesday that it has entered a tentative deal to acquire Carbonic Industries Corp, the fourth largest producer of carbon dioxide in the United States.

In a separate transaction, Airgas said it has agreed to acquire Shell Land & Energy Co's interests in leases producing carbon dioxide in the Northeast Jackson Dome area of Mississippi and an adjoining 183-mile carbon dioxide pipeline from the Shell Oil unit.
Financial terms of the deals were not disclosed.

Carbonic Industries, based in Duluth, Georgia, is a major producer and distributor in the Eastern United States of liquid carbon dioxide and dry ice and posted annual sales of $45 million. That deal for Airgas common stock and cash is expected to close by February 1, 1997.
The Northeast Jackson Dome assets include the largest industrially-marketed underground carbon dioxide reserves in the United States, the company said.
Current revenues from these customers approximate $9.5 million per year on annual deliveries of approximately 21 billion cubic feet of carbon dioxide, the company said.
